root_idea.summary: The root centers on remaining firmly in a state or place and maintaining a condition without interruption.
root_idea.development: From staying and continued adherence, the root develops meanings of prolonged or perpetual existence, attachment or reliance, unchanged youth, and things that remain fixed or attached.

senses.definition: To remain or abide indefinitely; to live forever.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic Form I occurrences, the imperfect denotes continued existence without an indicated end.

senses.definition: To cause someone or something to remain or abide permanently; to make immortal.
senses.usage_conditions: In 104:3, the verb describes wealth being imagined to make its possessor immortal.

senses.definition: To incline or attach oneself to, and rely upon, something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction أَخْلَدَ إِلَى describes turning toward and relying upon the earth or worldly life, rather than literal residence.

senses.definition: Perpetually youthful or unchanged in age; not subject to decrepitude.
senses.usage_conditions: This is an interpretation of مُخَلَّدُونَ in the Quranic description of those whose age and condition do not deteriorate.

senses.definition: Adorned with earrings or other ear ornaments.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the alternative Quranic interpretation of مُخَلَّدُونَ reported for the same passages.

senses.definition: One who abides or remains forever; everlasting or immortal.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic active participle is used of beings or groups destined to remain perpetually in a stated condition or abode.
The noun occurs in Quranic genitive expressions for an enduring state, including an abode or punishment characterized by perpetual existence.

senses.definition: Perpetual existence; eternity or abiding without decay.
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun denotes the state or duration of remaining permanently.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, stay, dwell, or continue for a long time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An ordinary intransitive use, including remaining in a place or dwelling; the perpetually abiding use is separately represented among the Quranic senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be slow to become gray and retain youthful signs in old age.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use describing continued youthfulness as though one were created to last forever.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To adorn someone with earrings, bracelets, or similar ornaments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form II use; the source's mention of a girl is illustrative, not a restriction on the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep or cling to a companion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with بِـ for maintaining attachment to someone; distinct from أَخْلَدَ إِلَى, ‘to incline or rely upon’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Paradise, the world to come, or an abode of perpetual existence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional designation, especially in دَارُ الْخُلْدِ, ‘the abode of perpetual existence’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bracelet or earring; collectively, personal ornaments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use distinct from the abstract meaning of perpetual existence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mole or blind rat, especially a naturally eyeless subterranean animal; also a species of rat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The entry also records variant forms associated with this animal name.
Used for what is settled within a person's inward thought or feeling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part of a person that remains unchanged while the person is alive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal designation for a bodily part distinguished by its persistence of condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something that remains fixed in place, such as the stones of a hearth; figuratively, a mountain, stone, or rock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from enduring in place; the references to hearth stones and rocks are lexical applications of that idea.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Slow to become gray, with hair remaining black in old age; also one whose teeth do not fall out because of extreme age.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjective describing delayed physical aging.
A rare figurative extension recorded in the lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An animal whose milk incisors remain until its permanent teeth emerge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal description based on persistence of the teeth.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Ordinary remaining and perpetual abiding are both covered.
Form II adornment use is represented.
Causative remaining and the Quranic immortality construction are covered.
The بِـ attachment construction is represented.
Inclining to and relying upon the earth or world is represented.
The noun is identified both as an infinitive and as synonymous with خُلُود.
Conventional designation of Paradise or the world to come.
Bracelet, earring, and collective ornament meanings are represented.
The mole or blind-rat meaning is represented.
Mind or heart meaning is represented.
Remaining or staying is covered by the Quranic active-participle sense.
The related mountain, stone, and rock uses are represented.
Delayed graying and retained black hair or teeth are represented.
The Quran-attested unchanged-youth interpretation is represented.
The Quran-attested ornament interpretation is represented.

cautions: مُخَلَّدُونَ in 56:17 and 76:19 has two explicitly reported interpretations in the supplied lexical evidence: perpetually youthful or unchanged, and adorned with earrings or other ornaments; both are retained rather than collapsed.
أَخْلَدَ إِلَى is a conventional attachment-and-reliance construction and should not be read as merely the causative of physical residence.
